candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record documents firm tumorous nodular swellings of the face/forehead/temples, rippled skin texture, progressive neurological involvement, and deep dermal mucin on Hale's colloidal iron staining after initial negative PAS/Alcian blue — all hallmarks of scleromyxedema. The reference diagnosis 'Atypical Tuberous Myxoedema (Scleromyxoedema variant)' is a recognized alias for the same condition; C001 names the same entity with the confirmatory histological finding explicitly stated.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Scleromyxedema with deep dermal mucin maps directly to Atypical Tuberous Myxoedema (Scleromyxoedema variant); both denote the same diagnostic entity with mucin deposition confirmed by Hale's colloidal iron staining in the deep dermis, tumorous nodular skin infiltration, and systemic features consistent with scleromyxedema

case_quality_flags: Hale's colloidal iron positivity with negative PAS/Alcian blue is an atypical but documented mucin staining pattern in scleromyxedema — clinically important nuance
No paraprotein/SPEP result documented; monoclonal gammopathy workup would strengthen diagnosis
Sudanese descent and travel history noted but not clearly linked to an alternative infectious etiology — differential with leishmaniasis or other granulomatous infections should be flagged
